The illustrated title page visibly identifies this game and matches the linked rules edition; reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently cleaned the litter box starts the first space expedition. Give that player the rocket board, rocket marker, and all the dice.
clarifications: The starting player is the initial commander of the expedition; the other players place astronauts clockwise in rocket-board order.
After each expedition, pass the rocket board to the player on the left. That player starts the next expedition.
